extensionDescription.message: Shows your sent replies inside the conversation threads of the folder where the conversation lives (e.g. the Inbox), not only in the Sent folder.

menuThread.message: Add my sent replies to this thread

menuFolder.message: Add my sent replies to this folder's threads

notifyNone.message: No new sent messages found for "$FOLDER$".

notifyBusy.message: Already working, please wait until the current task finishes.

notifyIneligible.message: This folder can't hold copies of sent messages (it is a Sent, Drafts, Trash, Junk, unified or virtual folder).

notifyWorking.message: Looking for your sent replies in "$FOLDER$"…

optAuto.message: When I send a reply, also copy it to the folder(s) holding the message I replied to

optDays.message: When adding sent replies to a whole folder, look at sent messages from the last N days:

optHelp.message: The original stays in your Sent folder; a copy is placed next to the conversation so Thunderbird threads it. Right-click a message ("Add my sent replies to this thread") or a folder ("Add my sent replies to this folder's threads") to fix older conversations.
